words.meaning: The quality of possessing transcendent beauty, grandeur, or exalted artistic excellence that inspires awe.
words.sentence1: The sublimity of the cathedral's vaulted ceiling moved visitors to reverent silence. (The sublimity of the cathedral's vaulted ceiling moved visitors to reverent silence.)
words.sentence2: Romantic painters sought to capture the terrifying sublimity of natural landscapes. (Romantic painters sought to capture the terrifying sublimity of natural landscapes.)

words.meaning: Gracefulness, elegance, and natural charm in movement, speech, or artistic presentation.
words.sentence1: La bailarina ejecutaba cada paso con un donaire que cautivaba al publico. (The dancer executed every step with a graceful charm that captivated the audience.)
words.sentence2: Las esculturas clasicas destacan por su equilibrio y elegante donaire. (Classical sculptures stand out for their balance and elegant grace.)

words.meaning: The quality of extreme delicacy, elegance, and cultivated taste in artistic expression or design.
words.sentence1: Ce tableau temoigne d'un grand raffinement dans le choix des nuances. (This painting demonstrates great refinement in the choice of shades.)
words.sentence2: L'architecture du palais brille par le raffinement de ses sculptures en marbre. (The palace's architecture shines through the refinement of its marble sculptures.)

words.meaning: Delicate grace, charm, and natural visual or emotional harmony.
words.sentence1: Die Skulptur strahlte eine vollkommene Ruhe und Anmut aus. (The sculpture radiated a complete tranquility and grace.)
words.sentence2: Ihre Bewegungen auf der Theaterbuehne waren von seltener Anmut erfuellt. (Her movements on the theatrical stage were filled with rare grace.)

words.meaning: Refined elegance, artistic taste, and classical poetic charm.
words.sentence1: Kare wa fuga na teien o nagamenagara uta o yonda. (He recited poetry while gazing upon the elegantly refined garden.)
words.sentence2: Sono togei sakuhin wa fuga na omomuki o kamoshidashite iru. (That ceramic work evokes a feeling of refined aesthetic grace.)

words.meaning: A deliberate, studied nonchalance or effortless grace that conceals the immense skill and effort behind a work of art.
words.sentence1: Il maestro dipinse il ritratto con una sprezzatura che nascondeva anni di rigido studio. (The master painted the portrait with an effortless grace that concealed years of rigorous study.)
words.sentence2: La sua esecuzione al pianoforte era permeata di un'elegante sprezzatura. (His piano performance was permeated with an elegant and effortless artistry.)

words.meaning: Artistic spirit, inner charm, and poetic resonance found in painting, calligraphy, or performance.
words.sentence1: Zhe fu shuimohua chongman le gudian de shenyun. (This ink wash painting is rich with classical artistic charm.)
words.sentence2: Yishu jia bixia de meiyipi ma dou you zhe du te de shenyun. (Every horse under the artist's brush possesses a unique spirit and vitality.)

words.meaning: A refined aesthetic sensibility centered on savoring nature, elegance, music, and the poetic arts.
words.sentence1: Seonbideureun jeongjaeseo siwa eum-ageul jeulgimyeo pungryureul jeulgida. (Scholars cultivated artistic elegance while enjoying poetry and music in the pavilion.)
words.sentence2: Hanguk jeontong yesureun jayeongwa johwareul iruneun pungryuui moti damgyeoitda. (Traditional Korean art embodies the tasteful aesthetic charm of living in harmony with nature.)

words.meaning: Artistic decoration, ornamentation, or creative aesthetic composition.
words.sentence1: Kompheang prasat man rochana knong kbach khmer yaung la-or. (The temple walls feature beautiful artistic designs in the Khmer ornamental style.)
words.sentence2: Ka rochana pka knong banteay nih thveu oy man somphos chea khlang. (The artistic floral arrangement in this room creates immense visual beauty.)

words.meaning: Gracefulness, ornamental elegance, and aesthetic beauty in form or design.
words.sentence1: Die sierlikheid van die gebou se gewels het dadelik almal se aandag getrek. (The graceful elegance of the building's gables immediately caught everyone's attention.)
words.sentence2: Sy het die fyn patrone met groot sierlikheid en geduld geskilder. (She painted the delicate patterns with great gracefulness and patience.)
